independent_oracles: Forward voltage/current sources yield 3 V and 2 V across 1 ohm loads; IMG(3+2j) yields a model value of 2.
Seed-37 reference streams verify shared source/model/ordinary/global values and the untouched next draw for AUNIF, AGAUSS, two-argument LIMIT and user functions, including repeated finalization.
Forward global temperature, TNOM, source and model bindings share the same sampled ambient value.
Public DC and AC-magnitude sensitivity of base^2 at base=2 equals 4.
Runtime global voltage follows 1+t through a complete 10 ms transient in both expression dialects.
Deterministic global projections follow a redefined dependency, ordinary values shadow globals, lazy branches tolerate unselected missing values and real cycles are rejected.
Unit checks exercise independent namespace samples, complex shared materialization, two/three-argument LIMIT, function overrides/formals and indirect runtime dependencies.
